# Game Idea: Orbital Dodge

- **Genre**: Arcade / Action
- **Core mechanic**: Player controls a ship orbiting a planet, switching between inner and outer orbit (or moving radially) to dodge incoming asteroids that spawn from the edges and head toward the planet.
- **Lose condition**: Collision with any asteroid or running out of fuel (fuel depletes over time).
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible, earning points for each asteroid avoided.

<content>
1: // Simple Orbital Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: // The player controls a ship that orbits a planet. Press Space or click to toggle
4: // between inner (radius 80) and outer (radius 140) orbit. Asteroids spawn from the
5: // canvas edges and move toward the planet. Collision ends the game. Fuel depletes
6: // over time; when it reaches zero the game ends.
7: 
8: (() => {
9:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
10:   if (!canvas) {
11:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
12:     return;
13:   }
14:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
15:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth);
16:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight);
17: 
18:   // Game constants
19:   // Sound assets (place .wav/.mp3 files in same directory)
20:   const soundToggle = new Audio('toggle.wav');
21:   const soundCollision = new Audio('collision.wav');
22:   const soundSpawn = new Audio('spawn.wav');
23:   const soundMusic = new Audio('music.mp3');
24:   soundMusic.loop = true;
25:   soundMusic.volume = 0.3;
26:   soundMusic.play().catch(() => {});
27:   const PLANET_RADIUS = 30;
28:   const ORBIT_INNER = 80;
29:   const ORBIT_OUTER = 140;
30:   const SHIP_RADIUS = 8;
31:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 1.0;
32:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 2.5;
33:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
34:   const FUEL_DEPLETION_RATE = 0.02; // per frame
35: 
36:   // Generate starfield
37: const STAR_COUNT = 120;
38: const stars = [];
39: for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
40:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height });
41: }
42: 
43: let angle = 0; // radians
44:   let orbitRadius = ORBIT_INNER;
45:   let fuel = 100;
46:   let score = 0;
47:   let asteroids = [];
48:   let lastSpawn = 0;
49:   let running = true;
50: 
51:   // Helper functions
52:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
53: 
54:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
55:     soundSpawn.play();
56:     // Choose a side: 0=top,1=right,2=bottom,3=left
57:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
58:     let x, y;
59:     const margin = 10;
60:     if (side === 0) { // top
61:       x = rand(margin, width - margin);
62:       y = -margin;
63:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
64:       x = width + margin;
65:       y = rand(margin, height - margin);
66:     } else if (side === 2) { // bottom
67:       x = rand(margin, width - margin);
68:       y = height + margin;
69:     } else { // left
70:       x = -margin;
71:       y = rand(margin, height - margin);
72:     }
73:     // Direction towards planet centre
74:     const dx = width / 2 - x;
75:     const dy = height / 2 - y;
76:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
77:     const speed = rand(ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED, ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED);
78:     const vx = (dx / dist) * speed;
79:     const vy = (dy / dist) * speed;
80:     const size = rand(6, 12);
81:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, size });
82:   };
83: 
84:   const update = (delta) => {
85:     if (!running) return;
86:     // Update ship angle
87:     angle += 0.03; // constant angular speed
88:     // Update fuel
89:     fuel = Math.max(0, fuel - FUEL_DEPLETION_RATE);
90:     if (fuel === 0) running = false;
91:     // Update asteroids
92:     asteroids.forEach((a) => {
93:       a.x += a.vx;
94:       a.y += a.vy;
95:     });
96:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids & increase score
97:     asteroids = asteroids.filter((a) => {
98:       const off = a.x < -20 || a.x > width + 20 || a.y < -20 || a.y > height + 20;
99:       if (off) score++;
100:       return !off;
101:     });
102:     // Collision detection
103:     const shipX = width / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.cos(angle);
104:     const shipY = height / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.sin(angle);
105:     for (const a of asteroids) {
106:       const d = Math.hypot(a.x - shipX, a.y - shipY);
107:       if (d < a.size + SHIP_RADIUS) {
108:         running = false;
109:         soundCollision.play();
110:         break;
111:       }
112:     }
113:     // Spawn new asteroids
114:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
115:       spawnAsteroid();
116:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
117:     }
118:   };
119: 
120:   const draw = () => {
121:     // Background – starfield
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
123:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
124:     // Draw stars
125:     stars.forEach(s => {
126:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
127:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
128:     });
129:     // Planet with gradient
130:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS / 2, width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS);
131:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
132:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
133:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
134:     ctx.beginPath();
135:     ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:     ctx.fill();
137:     // Ship – triangle with slight glow
138:     const shipX = width / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.cos(angle);
139:     const shipY = height / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.sin(angle);
140:     ctx.save();
141:     ctx.translate(shipX, shipY);
142:     ctx.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
143:     const shipPath = new Path2D();
144:     shipPath.moveTo(0, -SHIP_RADIUS);
145:     shipPath.lineTo(SHIP_RADIUS * 0.8, SHIP_RADIUS);
146:     shipPath.lineTo(-SHIP_RADIUS * 0.8, SHIP_RADIUS);
147:     shipPath.closePath();
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
149:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
150:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
151:     ctx.fill(shipPath);
152:     ctx.restore();
153:     // Asteroids – irregular circles with gradient
154:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
155:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.size * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.size);
156:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#c55');
157:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#622');
158:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     // UI – fuel & score (unchanged)
164:     // UI – fuel & score
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
167:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(0)}%`, 10, 20);
168:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
169:     if (!running) {
170:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
171:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
172:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
174:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
175:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
176:     }
177:   };
178: 
179:   // Input – toggle orbit radius
180:   const toggleOrbit = () => {
181:     orbitRadius = orbitRadius === ORBIT_INNER ? ORBIT_OUTER : ORBIT_INNER;
182:     soundToggle.play();
183:   };
184:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
185:     if (e.code === 'Space') toggleOrbit();
186:   });
187:   canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleOrbit);
188: 
189:   // Main loop
190:   let lastTime = 0;
191:   const loop = (time) => {
192:     const delta = time - lastTime;
193:     lastTime = time;
194:     update(delta);
195:     draw();
196:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
197:   };
198:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199: })();

(End of file - total 199 lines)
</content>
